_comment: Shared adversarial + benign SQL corpus run through BOTH lib/sqlGuard.ts (TS) and ceiba_nl2sql.sqltools.guard (Python). The parity contract (docs/PYTHON_NL2SQL_SERVICE_PLAN.md §1.3): the Python guard must be AT LEAST as strict as the TS guard. For every case, `tsRejected` records what the TS guard does; the TS parity test asserts TS matches it, and the Python parity test asserts Python rejects everything TS rejects (and does not newly-reject a case both are expected to allow). Keep this file in sync when either guard changes.

cases.name: with cte select
cases.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT id FROM visits WHERE ts > now()) SELECT * FROM r

cases.name: select with count and time bound
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE ts > now() LIMIT 100

cases.name: merge
cases.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

cases.name: with body delete
cases.sql: WITH x AS (DELETE FROM t RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM x

cases.name: with body write verb in string literal
cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT 'DELETE' AS a) SELECT * FROM x

cases.name: select into
cases.sql: SELECT 1 AS a INTO newtable FROM t
